HEALTH POLICY MATHEMATICS REQUIREMENT","groupId":"a00e7945-6887-ef11-8474-000d3a37e3b6","position":5,"area":"Requirements"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Junior-level applicants with the highest grades overall who satisfactorily complete lower-division requirements will be given preference for admission to the major.

                                       

Required for admission:

Students must have an overall GPA of 3.0 (3.4 for TAG) and complete all required courses with a cumulative minimum GPA of 3.0


  • One year (2 semesters or 3 quarters) of Social Science courses in any combination of the following topics:

Anthropology, Economics, Social Ecology, Political Science, Psychology, Sociology, and/or International Studies


NOTE: After matriculation, all courses required for Public Health majors must be successfully completed at UCI.


Important: Students have the following option for completing the Mathematics Requirement before enrolling at UCI:

1) Two quarters of Statistics equivalent to UCI's PUBHLTH 7A and PUBHLTH 7B

 - PUBHLTH 7A is equivalent to UCI's STATS 7 or STATS 8


NOTE: In fulfillment of the requirements below, a single course may be used only once.


For information regarding the AP and IB examination credit policies refer to the UCI General Catalogue. 


For more information regarding the UC Irvine Transfer Admission Guarantee Program, please visit TAG
